subtitle: Academic Writing
keywords: Effective report writing 2.Literature survey 3.Information collection and scrutiny
educationalGoal: (1) Learn how to write effective reports and academic papers (2) Understand the basic structure and components that improve reader understanding (3) Acquire effective writing skills
advice: We will mainly cover the following topics: 1. Understanding the basic structure and requirements of an effective report or paper. 2. Surveying literature to improve the quality of reports and to support report conclusions. 3. Writing a brief summary of a completed project in the Project Design course. 4. Writing a summary of a project proposal for Project Design III. Students are expected to actively participate in class. Students are expected to complete exercises independently. Students are required to be aware of the instructor’s messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class because the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
